prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star comp for a 16:9 browser-based Web Talk, opening moment
Primary request: Design a complete presentation viewport for pysubgroup using the committed Mesa de registro visual world. The screen must immediately express the question of finding a legible subgroup hidden by an aggregate, without looking like a software dashboard or a poster.
Scene/backdrop: top-down architectural drafting table translated into a semantic presentation interface
Subject: on the left, an abstract population field of many crisp data points crossed by one strong horizontal average line; three translucent tracing-paper sheets slightly misregistered over the field, with thick registration crosses and one unresolved rectangular region. On the right, a large clear Spanish question: ¿Qué combinación legible merece investigación? Bottom edge has quiet visible previous/next, direct-position dots and fullscreen control.
Style/medium: premium production web UI mockup, strong editorial information design, projector-legible, 16:9
Composition/framing: asymmetric 60/40 split, subject dominates, generous negative space around the question, controls small but visible
Color palette: mineral blue field occupying most of screen, graphite/navy text, cobalt selected geometry, tiny safety-orange only for caution
Materials/textures: convincing tracing paper and masking tape, opaque text bands, thick technical linework; texture never behind body copy
Typography: upright technical sans, not monospace except measurement, tabular numerals
Constraints: exact Spanish question verbatim; no other factual metrics; no churn values; no logos; no watermark; no gradient text; no glassmorphism; no SaaS cards; no neon; no warm cream; no serif; no decorative code; no tiny text; no scrolling page; this is a presentation viewport, not a poster
